newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, OTC slightly softer, trade th.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, OTC slightly softer, trade th.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were not traded on Monday morning, and a physical trader said the OTC market was also thin.
"The day ahead market's a little softer and the whole curve is a little weaker," the physical trader said, adding that it was a "typically quiet" Monday morning.

Futures saw bids and offers for each of the first nine months, as far forward as April 1998. Front month August was bid at 9.30 pence a therm against an offer at 9.60 pence, compared to a settlement price on Friday of 9.415 pence.

Transco released details of its plans to sell 4.7 teraWatt hours of storage gas in August and September over the weekend, but dealers said this had not had any discernible impact on the market on Monday morning.
